training._source: SegFormer's fine-tuning recipe (AdamW, lr 6e-5, head x10, poly decay); 320 px windows from FixedTrainDataset (90% on damage). Validation: pooled Dice on the full v2 val probes.

decision: Zero-shot is good enough only if its oracle upper bound reaches pooled Dice >= 0.5 on all probes, >= 0.3 on every contaminant, and beats the 'foreground' floor (whole finger = damage) by >= 0.1 on all probes and on every contaminant. Otherwise fine-tune (on v2).
